top_story: Israeli policy is tightening pressure on Palestinians even as Washington concentrates on keeping Gaza quiet: after troops forced West Bank families from their homes on 13 August, settlers moved on 17 August to establish a new illegal outpost, deepening a coercive displacement campaign that is reshaping daily life in the occupied territory. Against that backdrop, Jared Kushner’s rare meeting with Hamas in Egypt on 16 August and his subsequent talks with Benjamin Netanyahu point to an urgent effort to preserve the Gaza ceasefire. The regional picture is one in which diplomacy is narrowly focused on preventing immediate collapse in Gaza while Israeli military and settler actions continue to erode stability, protection, and prospects for de-escalation elsewhere.
